title.en: You may be able to get Medi-Cal

summary.en: Medi-Cal is free or low-cost health coverage in California. It includes prescriptions.

nextSteps.en: You can apply online, by phone, by mail, or at your county office.
Have proof of income and identity ready if you have it. The county will tell you what else it needs.
The county makes the decision, not this app.

title.en: You may be able to get care through Santa Clara County's PCAP

summary.en: The Primary Care Access Program offers low-cost primary care and prescriptions to uninsured adults 19 and older who live in Santa Clara County. Copays may apply.

sources.name: Valley Health Plan Network — Primary Care Access Program (PCAP)
sources.note: Seen in web-search results from vhpn.santaclaracounty.gov; the page itself could not be opened from the build environment (network blocked). Confirm before relying on it.

nextSteps.en: Call 1-888-363-3394 and choose option 1 for help enrolling.
PCAP is for people who cannot get other insurance, such as Medi-Cal.
